steps.title: Resuspend pellet in lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 350 µL of BME + RLT lysis buffer and vortex thoroughly.

steps.title: Homogenize lysate with QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to a purple QIAshredder tube and centrifuge at 21 300 × g (full speed) for 2 min.

steps.title: Add ethanol to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of 70 % ethanol to the homogenized lysate and mix well by pipetting.

steps.title: Optional freeze of flow‑through
steps.instruction: The flow‑through can be frozen at this stage and stored at –80 °C for several months.

steps.title: Load sample onto RNeasy column
steps.instruction: Transfer 700 µL of the sample (including any precipitate) to an RNeasy spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube, close the lid gently, centrifuge for 30 s at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer RW1
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Buffer RW1 to the spin column, close the lid gently, centrifuge for 30 s at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First wash with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer RPE to the spin column, close the lid gently, centrifuge for 30 s at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second wash with Buffer RPE
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step: add another 500 µL Buffer RPE, close the lid gently, centrifuge for 30 s at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm), and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column to remove residual buffer
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column for 2 min at full speed (≈9 391 × g) to eliminate any remaining buffer.

steps.title: Elute RNA – first spin
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 1.5 mL collection tube, add 20 µL RNase‑free water directly onto the membrane, close the lid gently, and centrifuge for 1 min at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm) to elute RNA.

steps.title: Re‑elute RNA for higher yield
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate back onto the spin‑column membrane and centrifuge again for 1 min at 9 391 × g (10 000 rpm). The RNA is now ready for downstream assays or can be stored at –80 °C.
